comment: ANCHOR: CODEX_LANE_QUOTA_HINT_20261107 — hermes-deep-research-local failed 13 consecutive runs

The session was fine. The lane's keepalive had been recording data/runtime/oauth_lane_status.json
chatgpt.kind=rate_limited (429 upstream, 56 consecutive failures, last ok 28 h earlier) the whole
time. The proxy answered with no content, the pseudo-TTY CLI (same OAuth session) produced nothing,
and the empty output was reported as an auth failure the operator cannot fix.
The fix: before the CLI fallback — and again if the CLI's output is empty — read the lane's own
fresh verdict and raise CODEX_UNAVAILABLE_RATE_LIMITED with the quota wall, the failing count and
no re-login hint. Stale, absent, unparseable or non-rate-limit verdicts change nothing, so a real
The gate pins both branches plus the healthy path. Hermetic: monkeypatched state file, proxy and
subprocess; no network, no proxy, no CLI, no OAuth session, no quota spend.
